description_en: Triggers the execution of a manual business process. The manual business process must have been submitted and published in the console, and the O&M center must be able to find the corresponding manual business process before you can call this operation
description_zh: 手动业务流程必须已经在界面提交发布，运维中心能够找到对应的手动业务流程，才能使用该接口
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-manual-dag --project-env 'PROD或者DEV' --project-name test_workspace --flow-name test_workflow --biz-date 2020-11-11_00:00:00 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateManualDag

parameters.help_en: The environment identifier of the O&M center. PROD indicates the production environment. DEV indicates the development environment
parameters.help_zh: 调度运维中心的环境标识。PROD表示生产环境，DEV表示开发环境
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The English name of the workspace to which the manual business process belongs
parameters.help_zh: 手动业务流程所属的工作空间英文名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the manual business process
parameters.name: flow_name

parameters.help_en:
The business date. The value must be less than or equal to the current date minus 1 day. For example, if today is November 11, 2020, the business date must be 00:00:00 on November 10, 2020 or an earlier date. The hour, minute, and second values of the business date must all be set to 00.

Format example: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`, such as `2020-11-11 00:00:00`
parameters.help_zh:
业务日期的值为小于等于当前日期-1天。例如，今天是2020年11月11日，则业务日期需要是2020年11月10日的00:00:00或者该日期之前的日期。业务日期的时分秒信息均填写00。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2020-11-11 00:00:00`
parameters.name: biz_date

parameters.help_en:
The node parameter information passed when the manual business process is executed. The value is in JSON format:
`
{
     "<Node ID within the manual business process>": "Scheduling parameter information of the node, in the same format as the parameters in the scheduling configuration of DataStudio", 
     "<Node ID within the manual business process>": "Scheduling parameter information of the node, in the same format as the parameters in the scheduling configuration of DataStudio"
}
`
parameters.help_zh:
传递手动业务流程执行时的节点参数信息，一个JSON格式：
`
{
     "<手动业务流程内部的某个节点ID>": "节点的调度参数信息，和数据开发调度配置里面的参数格式保持一致", 
     "<手动业务流程内部的某个节点ID>": "节点的调度参数信息，和数据开发调度配置里面的参数格式保持一致"
}
`
parameters.name: node_parameters

parameters.help_en: The business process parameters. These parameters are synchronized to all instances of the current dagrun. If the scheduling parameters of internal nodes reference the business process parameters in DagParameters, the corresponding parameter values of the nodes are replaced with the business process parameters in DagParameters
parameters.help_zh: 业务流程参数，该参数会同步至本次Dag的所有实例中。如果内部节点的调度参数引用了DagParameters中的业务流程参数，则节点的对应参数值会被替换为DagParameter中的业务流程参数
parameters.name: dag_parameters

parameters.help_en: The list of node IDs that need to be executed
parameters.name: include_node_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of node IDs that do not need to be executed
parameters.help_zh: 不需要运行的节点ID列表
parameters.name: exclude_node_ids

DagId.description_en: The instance ID of the dagrun for the manual business process. You can use this DagId with the corresponding operation to query the detailed information and status of the internal node instances of this manual business process execution
DagId.description_zh: 手动业务流程运行Dag的实例ID。您可以通过接口和该DagId查询此次手动业务流程运行的内部节点实例的详细信息和状态
